$comment: Real capture: GET /repos/actions/checkout/git/ref/tags/v4.2.0. A NON-moving dotted tag — and the proof of why pinning matters. GitHub RE-POINTED this tag between the first capture and the live oracle run (1d0ff469b7ec7b3cb9d8673fde0c81c44821de2a → d632683dd7b4114ad314bca15554477dd762a938) and both the API and `git ls-remote` agree on the new object. Only a SHA is immutable.
